thread:
anya: Quick proposal — want to switch our beta engagement flow to a staged intake (3 overlap cohorts) + short async feedback windows. Goal: get high signal quickly without burning ops. Thoughts?

miguel: +1 to staged. can we define concrete windows? eg week 0 invite, week 1-2 intensive feedback, week 3-6 monitoring/slow expand?

sasha: liking the 2-week intensive window. practical ask: make the feedback “one-click” for customers (short form + example prompt run). lower friction = more signal.

jordan: agree. also add a lightweight telemetry checklist customers opt into: latency, tokens/req, failure rate, and sample outputs for eval. link to telemetry template: https://redwood.internal/telemetry/template (WIP)

anya: rough cohorts I want to target (different from usual): 1) integrators (devs embedding), 2) compliance-heavy (on-prem/VPC), 3) low-latency apps (streaming). stagger start by 1 week each to let infra tune.

miguel: + cohorts. for acceptance gates propose: quantitative + qualitative. Quant: <1.5x latency vs baseline, error rate <2% above baseline, eval pass rate >= 90% on canonical prompts. Qual: >=2 signed customer signoffs that they can run their core flow.

sasha: can we also require at least one regression test per partner in the harness? otherwise we miss edge cases.

jordan: suggested rollout policy: canary 10% traffic -> 30% -> full. each step waits for 48h with health checks. if any metric crosses threshold rollback automatically to previous variant.

anya: documented gating + rollout must be in the design partner pack. owners: eng-eval to own harness + automation, solutions to own partner onboarding + short survey, legal to own simplified dp NDA.

miguel: note on instrumentation: we should tag events with cohort and invite_wave (eg invite_wave=1). makes slicing easier in Console. also add a `beta_feedback_score` numeric field to capture quick thumbs (1-5).

sasha: incentive note — small credits + concierge session for integrators; compliance cohort needs a security review slot. we should script the security questionnaire and send it pre-invite.

anya: minimal eval CLI for eng-eval: ```sh
run_eval --suite=beta-onboarding --k=500 --report=./reports/wave1.json
```
please make it produce pass/fail + regression delta.

beta-bot: Reminder: scheduled DP kickoff meeting set for 2024-11-12 16:00 PT. Agenda: cohort definitions, gating matrix, instrumentation hooks. :calendar:

jordan: action items: 1) eng-eval draft harness by EOD Tue, 2) solutions onboarding script by Wed, 3) legal NDA template final by Fri. assign owners on the shared doc.

miguel: +1 on timeline. will prototype tagging + report fields today.

sasha: i'll draft the 2-week feedback form (short + one example request) and share by morning.

anya: sweet. main risk: partners churn if feedback is too heavy. keep the ask <10 minutes per week. we can iterate form after wave1. :thumbsup:

jordan: solid. linking to the roadmap ticket: https://redwood.internal/roadmap/ENG-7421 (tracking gating + rollout).

anya: thanks all — will update the design partner pack and ping folks as tasks complete.
